llc.formation_doc: Articles of Organization (Florida Limited Liability Company)
llc.formation_notes: $100 filing fee for articles of organization plus $25 for the certificate designating the registered agent = $125 (s. 605.0213, F.S.). Certified copy $30 and certificate of status $5 are optional. Sunbiz fee page (dos.fl.gov) blocked automated reading today; amounts taken from the statute.

annual_report.name: Annual Report
annual_report.due: between January 1 and May 1 each year, starting the year after formation
annual_report.late_penalty: $400 late charge if filed after May 1 (s. 607.193(2)(b))

state_tax_on_llc.name: Supplemental corporate fee (collected with the annual report)
state_tax_on_llc.applies: every business entity, including LLCs, that must file an annual report
state_tax_on_llc.notes: Annual report fee = $50 (s. 605.0213(5)) + $88.75 supplemental corporate fee (s. 607.193) = $138.75. No franchise tax on LLCs taxed as partnerships or disregarded.

state_tax_on_llc.name: Florida corporate income/franchise tax (only if LLC elects to be taxed as a C corporation)
state_tax_on_llc.applies: LLCs classified as corporations for federal and Florida purposes; not LLCs classified as partnerships or disregarded
state_tax_on_llc.notes: $50,000 exemption subtracted before applying the rate

sources.quote: an annual supplemental corporate fee of $88.75 is imposed on each business entity that is authorized to transact business in this state

entity_level_taxes.name: Corporate income tax on S corporations only for income taxed federally (built-in gains / passive income, Form 1120S line 23c)
entity_level_taxes.notes: Otherwise an S corporation does not have to file a Florida corporate income tax return; $50,000 exemption applies

sources.title: Florida DOR - Corporate Income Tax
sources.quote: S corporations that pay federal income tax on Line 23c of Federal Form 1120S.

sources.title: Florida DOR - Corporate Income Tax (individuals not covered)
sources.quote: Corporations, including entities that are taxed federally as corporations, are subject to the tax.

estimated_tax.required_if: No state individual income tax, so no individual estimated payments
estimated_tax.notes: Corporations (incl. LLCs taxed as C corps) owing more than $2,500 make corporate estimated payments (not verified today)

unemployment_2026.notes: Florida reemployment tax; employer-only; applies to an S corp owner's own W-2 salary

notable: No personal income tax; S corp and LLC pass-through income is not taxed by the state (https://floridarevenue.com/taxes/taxesfees/Pages/corporate.aspx)
LLC annual report is $138.75 and a $400 late charge applies after May 1 (http://www.leg.state.fl.us/statutes/index.cfm?App_mode=Display_Statute&URL=0600-0699/0607/Sections/0607.193.html)
LLC taxed as C corp pays 5.5% corporate income tax after a $50,000 exemption (https://floridarevenue.com/taxes/taxesfees/Pages/corporate.aspx)
